Notes from the two slide packs, grouped by topic rather than lecture:
logic control and ladder logic, PLCs, industrial communications, automated
assembly and parts feeding, and the performance and cost of assembly systems.
Every chapter ends with its interactive applets (77 in all), running in the
page. The Statistical Process Control part of the module is not included.
